thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: P1 triggered — SmartRouting policy misroute detected (rollout id rlt_2026_11c). Canary traffic being routed to an incompatible variant (gptx-13k-quant-v2) causing tokenization errors and cascading fallbacks. Auto-fallback set to 'sticky' caused repeated region hops. Root time: 1833456789

alex: I'm on it — oncall (alex) checking logs and current rollout state.

maria: Heads up, I'm pulling traces for requests that hit the canary. Early sign: content-type mismatch errors and 502s from the variant.

sanjay: I see the policy evaluation trace — policy 'canary-plus-fallback' matched a variant alias that shouldn't be eligible for this model family. Probable config drift after last policy release.

emily: Customer-facing impact: 3 enterprise customers reported increased 5xx rates and chunked streaming failures starting ~2m ago. CS on standby.

deploy-bot: Deploy event rlt_2026_11c started 1833456700 by tony. Canary set to 5% across us-east1; sticky fallback target: nearest-available-variant.

alex: Can we pause the rollout? Command?

sanjay: Pause now: use the rollout CLI or Console. CLI:

```
redwood rollout pause --id rlt_2026_11c --reason "misroute causing P1"
```

alex: Running pause...

ops-bridge: @alex confirm pause command executed and observed in control plane?

alex: Pause returned OK. Control plane shows state PAUSED.

maria: Good. Now we need to remove the sticky fallback or change fallback policy to non-sticky for this rollout to stop oscillation across regions. Current sticky behavior is causing user sessions to chase failing variants.

sanjay: Recommend ROLLBACK of the canary variant binding change in routing policy. Quick config diff:

```
- fallback: {type: sticky, order: [region, cost-tier]}
+ fallback: {type: stateless, order: [priority, region]}
```

tony: If we change fallback to stateless mid-rollout does that risk wider impact? Product wants minimum blast radius.

maria: Switching to stateless prevents session stickiness to a bad variant but could increase cold-starts. Given active 5xxs, stateless is safer.

emily: I'll draft the customer comms: "We're investigating elevated error rates for some generation calls; mitigation in progress. Expect updates in 30 minutes."

alex: I'll patch the policy via Console to set fallback=stateless and remove the bad variant alias from eligibleVariants. Pushing patch now.

deploy-bot: Policy change request submitted by alex: change_policy(policy_id=pol_canary_v2, set=fallback=stateless, remove_variant=gptx-13k-quant-v2).

alex: Patch applied. Control plane shows policy revision pol_canary_v2@5.

maria: Observability — I'm watching the routing logs. I still see short-lived hops as cached sticky keys expire, but error rate is trending down from 14% -> 4% in the last 90s.

sanjay: Also evict prefix cache for the canary group to accelerate convergence:

```
redwood cache evict --group canary-rlt_2026_11c
```

alex: Eviction done.

ops-bridge: @sanjay are we safe to resume rollout after we validate a clean 10m window? Ops prefers a canary rollback rather than resume.

sanjay: My recommendation: keep rollout paused, remove variant alias from catalog, run a small internal smoke test, then either resume with corrected policy or rollback.

tony: Product prefers resume (with corrected policy) if no regressions in smoke test.

maria: For now, mark incident severity: P1 -> partial customer impact (3 customers), degraded streaming, 12m duration so far. Tagging incident for postmortem: "canary-variant-misroute-sticky-fallback".

emily: CS updated customers and appended monitoring links.

alex: Running a smoke test against corrected routing (internal tokens only). Test scenario: 100 requests, varying sequence lengths.

(alex runs smoke)

alex: Smoke results: 0 5xx, latency normal, tokenization errors gone.

deploy-bot: Rollout rlt_2026_11c remains PAUSED per user action at 1833456798.

maria: OK to close pager? I'd like to keep incident open as INVESTIGATING until postmortem created.

alex: Closing pager now (paging system). Notifying on-call for follow-up and postmortem: @maria owner, @sanjay infra, @tony product.

incident-bot: Pager closed by alex at 1833456902. Incident ticket created: INC-2026-8347.

emily: I'll file the customer impact summary into the ticket: affected endpoints, time window 1833456700–1833456890, mitigation steps performed.

tony: Action items: 1) roll back bad variant alias from model catalog permanently. 2) add unit test to policy deploy pipeline to detect incompatible variant-family mappings. 3) run failover simulation to ensure sticky fallback doesn't cause loops.

maria: Adding timeline and logs to INC-2026-8347. Planning 1-hour postmortem meeting in ops-calendar.

sanjay: Follow-up: I'll prepare a hotfix to the policy validator and a short runbook update for sticky fallbacks.

alex: Thanks team. I'm setting a reminder to resume/rollback decision after the smoke test plus 30m observation.

emily: Noting CS follow-up for the impacted customers.

ops-bridge: Reaction: :white_check_mark: mitigation successful, leave incident open for postmortem and policy fixes.

maria: Incident handoff to morning oncall @sanjay in 40m.

sanjay: Ack, will take handoff and own postmortem.

(End of thread)
